lucidity.name: Fantastic Imagination
lucidity.text: Reveal 1 Landscape. If Lucidity 0-2, Reveal +1. If Lucidity 3+, Return 3 Cards.

lucidity.name: Centering
lucidity.text: Draw 2 Psyche. All Dreamers Draw 1 Psyche & 1 Power Token. Then Move to an adjacent Landscape.

lucidity.name: The Ascent
lucidity.text: Discard your highest Psyche, then Draw 2 Psyche. Dreamers on Affected Landscapes may also use this effect.

lucidity.name: Beyond Comprehension
lucidity.text: Flip Leviathan. Instead, Forget 4 Landscapes. Return 4 cards.

lucidity.name: Just a Dream
lucidity.text: Draw 3 Psyche. Return 1 Card for each Affected Landscape.

lucidity.name: Morning Routine
lucidity.text: Draw 1 Psyche. Draw Psyche up to Landscapes Affected. Repress top 1 Lucidity Mindstream card.

lucidity.name: Afternoon Nap
lucidity.text: Draw 1 Psyche. If less than your Lucidity, Return cards up to your Lucidity. Keep Psyche.

lucidity.name: Evening Plans
lucidity.text: Draw 1 Psyche OR flip top of 1 Deck. Draw 2 Lucidity Encounters and place on Landscapes adjacent to Day in the Life.

lucidity.name: I Know This Place!
lucidity.text: Return 1 Card. Return +Dreamers Cards.

lucidity.name: I'm Still Dreaming
lucidity.text: Discard 2 Psyche. Move to Insanity or Day in the Life.

lucidity.name: A Way Out Forms
lucidity.text: Discard 1 Psyche. May Discard Psyche up to Landscapes Affected to flip top cards of any deck.

lucidity.name: Voice in the Distance
lucidity.text: Take 1 Power Token. Move to Road or Endless Hallway.

lucidity.name: Something's Over There
lucidity.text: May Discard 1 Psyche to Draw a Dreambeast and place on any Landscape. Instead, Draw 2 Encounters, Choose 1.

lucidity.name: A Face Appears
lucidity.text: Spawn 1 Encounter from Lucidity Mindstream. If Lucidity 3+, Return 3 Cards.

lucidity.name: Mist Swirls
lucidity.text: Discard 1 Dream. If Lucidity 3+, Discard 1 Psyche to Reveal Persona+1 Landscapes.

lucidity.name: Transported
lucidity.text: Draw 2 Psyche. 1st is column, 2nd is row of Dreamscape. Move to this Landscape.

lucidity.name: Lightness
lucidity.text: Draw 2 Psyche. Discard 1 Psyche; all Dreamers may Draw Psyche up to the value of the card.

lucidity.name: The Council of The Years
lucidity.text: Draw 4 Psyche, Repress 3, keep 1. Instead, Draw 4 Dreambeasts, Repress 3, Meet 1 now.

lucidity.name: Sublimation
lucidity.text: Discard 1 Psyche to Return 1 Card and take 1 Power Token. Discard up to 4 Psyche to Return up to 4 cards from the Subconscious.

lucidity.name: Serenity
lucidity.text: Draw +3 Psyche. Take 1 Power Token. Move to The Party or Day in the Life.

lucidity.name: Harmonic Resonance
lucidity.text: If Lucidity 1, Draw 1 Psyche. If Lucidity 3+, Return 2 Cards. Draw +1 Psyche or Return +2.

lucidity.name: Denial
lucidity.text: Return 4 Cards. If Lucidity 3+, Return +Dreamers.

lucidity.name: Keep it Together
lucidity.text: Repress Objects from hand unless you Discard Psyche equal to the number of Objects you wish to spare.

lucidity.name: Metamorphosis
lucidity.text: Repress Active Encounters+2 top Psyche. Forget 2 Landscapes per Affected Landscape.

lucidity.name: Contagion
lucidity.text: Repress top 2 Psyche. Lucidity 2 or less, Repress +1 per Affected Landscape.

lucidity.name: Forgot Clothes
lucidity.text: Repress 1 Psyche from hand. If Lucidity 1-2, Move adjacent. If Lucidity 3+, Move anywhere.

lucidity.name: Wrong Classroom
lucidity.text: Repress top of Lucidity Mindstream. Discard Active Encounters+1 Psyche from hand.

lucidity.name: Everyone's Laughing
lucidity.text: Discard 2 Objects. Lucidity 3+, Instead Discard 1 Psyche. Discard Psyche equal to half Active Encounters (min 1).

lucidity.name: Pop Quiz
lucidity.text: Draw 1 Psyche. Guess if next Psyche is Higher or Lower. Correct: Return Dreamers+3.

lucidity.name: Revolving
lucidity.text: Draw 3 Psyche. Repress 1 Psyche from hand. Swap Positions with any other Dreamer.

lucidity.name: Blooming
lucidity.text: Swap Positions of any 4 unoccupied Landscape Hexes. Repress 1 Psyche from hand.

lucidity.name: Break-out
lucidity.text: Discard 1 Psyche. Draw 1 Psyche. If it matches a Psyche in your hand, Return 4 Cards.

lucidity.name: Sacred Geometry
lucidity.text: Move to any Landscape adjacent to Bed. Return 2 Cards per Affected Landscape.

lucidity.name: Caught Cheating
lucidity.text: Discard 1 Psyche. Draw 1 Psyche. If it matches hand, Return 4 Cards; if not, discard 1 Psyche.

lucidity.name: Feel, Deal, Heal
lucidity.text: Flip Leviathan. Discard your lowest Psyche, shuffle Psyche Discard into Deck, Draw 1 Psyche. Draw +1 per Affected Landscape.

elasticity.name: A Shining Wind
elasticity.text: If Elasticity 3+, take 2 Power Tokens. Move to Silver Mist or Endless Ocean.

elasticity.name: A Million Reflections
elasticity.text: Repress choice of 4 Discarded Mindstream Cards. Return 4 Cards.

elasticity.name: This Will Have to Do
elasticity.text: May Discard 1 Psyche less than or equal to your Elasticity to Draw 2 Psyche.

elasticity.name: Is That Music?
elasticity.text: Discard 1 Psyche to Draw 1 Psyche. Elasticity 3+, Take 1 Power Token and Move to Awards or The Party.

elasticity.name: Roof Dive
elasticity.text: Elasticity 3+, Move to Sky, The Party, or Candy Mountain.

elasticity.name: Cotton Candy
elasticity.text: May Discard 1 Psyche to Draw Psyche up to value. Move to Candy Mountain Refreshed! Draw 3 Psyche.

elasticity.name: Insulation
elasticity.text: Keep this card. Next Explore, Move+1. Then Discard this card.

elasticity.name: Shimmering Slivers
elasticity.text: Draw 1 Object. Draw 1 Psyche for each Affected Landscape.

elasticity.name: Diamonds
elasticity.text: Discard 1 Psyche to Draw 1 Psyche and Return 4 Cards from Subconscious and Take 1 Power Token.

elasticity.name: Desert Oasis
elasticity.text: Draw 3 Psyche and Take 1 Power Token. Move to House or Suburbia.

elasticity.name: Need Water!
elasticity.text: Discard 1 Psyche. Discard 1 Willpower Psyche or Discard all Objects.

elasticity.name: Into The Next
elasticity.text: All Dreamers Draw 1 Psyche. Repress top 1 Elasticity Mindstream. Move to adjacent Landscape & take a free Action.

elasticity.name: Broken Toys
elasticity.text: Discard 2 Psyche. Draw 2 Psyche.

elasticity.name: Flooded
elasticity.text: Elasticity 1-2, Move to Endless Ocean. Elasticity 3+, Move to House or Suburbia.

elasticity.name: Running Somewhere?
elasticity.text: Draw 1 Psyche. Elasticity 3+, May Discard 1 Psyche to Return cards equal to value.

elasticity.name: Portal to Another World
elasticity.text: Elasticity 0-2 Move 1. Elasticity 3+ Move 3. Move to edge of Dreamscape.

elasticity.name: Giant Animated Pile
elasticity.text: Draw 1 Dreambeast, Meet Now at half Accept & Repress cost.

elasticity.name: Dust Bunnies
elasticity.text: Draw 1 Dreambeast. Repress this Dreambeast & 1 Psyche. Draw 1 Object.

elasticity.name: Lost Treasure
elasticity.text: Elasticity 0-2, Discard 1 Psyche. Elasticity 3+, Draw 3 Psyche. Return 1 Card per Affected Landscape.

elasticity.name: Wrong Door
elasticity.text: Return 2 Dreambeasts from Accept Pile and Spawn on adjacent Landscapes. If can't, Discard 4 Psyche.

elasticity.name: Hidden in the Walls
elasticity.text: Draw 1 Psyche. Draw 1 Dreambeast: Draw 5 Psyche, Meet Now, Fail cost doubled.

elasticity.name: Deeper Darker
elasticity.text: Elasticity 1-2, Discard 1 Psyche. Elasticity 3+, Draw 1 Object. If all Affected Landscapes Revealed, All Dreamers Draw 2 Psyche.

elasticity.name: Undulating Floor
elasticity.text: Move to Any Landscape. Place 1 Power Token on an available Archetype.

elasticity.name: The Right Door
elasticity.text: Elasticity 0-2, Discard 1 Psyche. Elasticity 3+, Draw 3 Psyche.

elasticity.name: Just out of Reach
elasticity.text: Elasticity 3+, Discard 1 Psyche to Return cards up to Affected Landscapes.

elasticity.name: Splinters
elasticity.text: Draw 2 Dreambeasts. Spawn 1 on Endless Hallway and 1 on Attic. If not, Discard 2 Psyche.

elasticity.name: Freezing Night
elasticity.text: Elasticity 0-2, Draw 2 Psyche keep 1. Willpower 3+, Draw 2 Objects keep 1.

elasticity.name: Searing Day
elasticity.text: Elasticity 0-2, Discard 2 Psyche. Elasticity 3+, Draw 2 Psyche.

elasticity.name: A Mirage?
elasticity.text: Spawn 1 Dreambeast, pay Fail cost first then resolve.

elasticity.name: Sandstorm!
elasticity.text: Elasticity 0-2, Discard 1 Object or Psyche. Elasticity 3+, Move to Tranquil Grove or Inner Sanctum.

elasticity.name: Friendship
elasticity.text: Reveal 2 Landscapes. Move to either. Elasticity 3+, 1 Free Action.

elasticity.name: Get Up
elasticity.text: Draw 1 Psyche from Discard. May Move to Forest if Revealed. Move to Attic and take free Meet.

elasticity.name: Get Down
elasticity.text: Draw 1 Psyche from Discard. May Move to City if Revealed. Move to Basement and take free Meet.

elasticity.name: Bronze
elasticity.text: Return 2 Dreambeasts from Accept Pile. Spawn 1 Dreambeast on any Affected Landscape.

elasticity.name: Silver
elasticity.text: Spawn 1 Dreambeast. Accept 1 Dreambeast on any Affected Landscape.

willpower.name: A Thousand Daggers
willpower.text: All Dreamers collectively Repress Dreamers+2 Psyche from hand.

willpower.name: Flashing Lights
willpower.text: Draw 2 Psyche. Take 2 Power Tokens.

willpower.name: Rhythm of the Night
willpower.text: May Discard 1 Object for all Dreamers to Draw 2 Psyche.

willpower.name: Roiling Doom
willpower.text: Discard 2 Psyche. Draw 2 Encounters, Immediately Meet 1, Discard other.

willpower.name: Perilous Pinnacle
willpower.text: Discard 2 Objects. Meet both Encounters in order of your choice.

willpower.name: Cooling Obsidian
willpower.text: Repress 1 Active Encounter. Move to Endless Ocean or Field of Broken Glass.

willpower.name: From the Fire
willpower.text: Return 2 Repressed Encounters. Return +2 Cards.

willpower.name: A Sacrifice!
willpower.text: Discard 1 Object to Return Dreamers+1 Objects. Repress Encounters on Affected Landscapes.

willpower.name: Heating Up
willpower.text: Spawn 1 Encounter, Meet it. If Accept spawn another; if Repress Draw Psyche up to hand limit.

willpower.name: No Thing
willpower.text: Discard 3 Dream Cards. Willpower 3+, Return 1 Dream card to deck and shuffle.

willpower.name: No Time
willpower.text: Collectively Discard 1 Object per Dreamer. May Repress 4 Mindstream to ignore.

willpower.name: No Where
willpower.text: Forget 4 Landscapes. Repress top 1 Psyche from Psyche deck. Draw 2 Psyche for grid move without Meet.

willpower.name: Choppy Water
willpower.text: Discard 1 Willpower Psyche to Draw 1 Psyche and Return 4 Cards.

willpower.name: Big Wave
willpower.text: Draw 1 Psyche. May Discard 1 Higher Value Psyche to Return 3 Cards.

willpower.name: Fog
willpower.text: Discard 1 Willpower Psyche to Draw 2 Psyche. Move to Silver Mist.

willpower.name: Clear as Crystal
willpower.text: Willpower 2 or less: Draw 3 Psyche. Willpower 3+: Draw 3 Psyche and Return 2.

willpower.name: A Mouth Rises
willpower.text: Flip Leviathan. If Awake, Move it to Endless Ocean.

willpower.name: Whirlpool
willpower.text: Willpower 1-2, Flip Leviathan. Willpower 3+, Move 2 toward Endless Ocean.

willpower.name: Syrup Lake
willpower.text: Take 1 Power Token. Draw 1 Psyche. Move to Candy Mountain.

willpower.name: Peppermint Peak
willpower.text: Discard 1 Willpower Psyche up to your Willpower to Draw 3 Psyche.

willpower.name: Licorice Bridge
willpower.text: Draw 1 Psyche and skip your next Explore phase.

willpower.name: Chocolate Mines
willpower.text: Draw 1 Psyche. Draw +2 Psyche for each Affected Landscape.

willpower.name: Marshmallow Clouds
willpower.text: Take 2 Power Tokens. May Draw 1 any Mindstream. All Dreamers Take 1 Power Token.

willpower.name: Jaw Shark
willpower.text: Discard 2 Willpower Psyche or else Repress 2 Psyche from hand. If unable, Discard all Objects.

willpower.name: Ivory Calm
willpower.text: Willpower 1-2: Draw 1 Psyche. Willpower 3+, Draw 1 Psyche and Return 3.

willpower.name: Tartar Algae
willpower.text: Draw +1 Psyche and Return +1 for Each Affected Landscape.

willpower.name: Caramel Forest
willpower.text: Draw 2 Encounters. Spawn 1 on Adjacent Landscape. Discard other.

willpower.name: Chewed to Dust
willpower.text: Repress top of Each Mindstream. Discard 3 Psyche or else Discard 1 Dream.

willpower.name: Gap in the Teeth
willpower.text: Draw 2 Psyche. Move to Candy Mountain or Endless Ocean.

willpower.name: Golden Tooth
willpower.text: Willpower 1-2: Draw 2 Psyche. Willpower 3+: Draw 1 Object from any Mindstream.

willpower.name: Who's There?
willpower.text: Spawn an Encounter and Meet Now. Instead, Draw 2 Encounters, Pick 1. Repress top 1 Willpower Mindstream card.

willpower.name: No Why
willpower.text: Draw from any Mindstream. All Dreamers may each Draw from any Mindstream.

willpower.name: No One
willpower.text: Discard all active Encounters. Willpower 3+, Instead Discard 1 Encounter.

willpower.name: I Remember!
willpower.text: May Discard 1 Psyche up to your Willpower to Return 1 Card. Return +Cards equal to your Willpower.

willpower.name: Dream Toll
willpower.text: Discard 1 Dream for Each Affected Landscape.
